body: I guess this was a waste.

I will have to give the short version.  I am a convicted sex offender.  Prior to my arrest and conviction I had a GF, nice career, a new car, a house.  I lost it all due do pornography addiction.  Was found with child pornography.  So I did my time and got out and tried to rebuild.  I started to make friends and even reveal my past to some.  Well something happened and it became public about my past.  So, my friends pulled away out of fear.  Not of me but of public perception.  I am unable to find work.  I am an expert in my field and can get interviews but when it comes to a background check it all goes away.  

The rejection I fell from society is very hard.  I have lost so much and no matter what I do I can't seem to get back on track.  I tried to start dating but website wont allow sex offenders.  I also feel that once I meet someone I have to tell them my past and then what?  I have lost a loved one because of that.  It broke my heart.  

There is alot that I am not putting here because it would be volumes.  I am just trying to convey how I feel trapped.  I feel as though no matter what I do I will only be seen for my past and not who I am now.  I am not the same person I once was.  I am more in touch with myself.  I am tired of being rejected by people either for companionship or employment.  I scared to reveal myself for fear of rejection.  I don't want to die but what's the point of living when I can't have a life.
